name: Nassourdine Imavov

face.shape: Long, rectangular face with a broad forehead and a broad lower face squared off by the beard; clearly longer than wide. Without fight-week leanness (2023 and 2024 photos) the cheeks are moderately full.
face.jaw: Moderately wide with defined angles, mostly hidden by the beard; the beard makes the lower face look broad and long.
face.chin: Medium width and moderately projecting (right profile at the UFC Paris weigh-in); the beard is longest at the chin.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high and broad; cheeks flat at fight week, a little fuller off camp (2024).
face.brow_ridge: Moderately prominent; the eyes look narrow and slightly deep-set under low brows.
face.forehead: Broad and medium-tall with faint horizontal lines.

eyes.shape: Almond with a narrow vertical opening and slightly hooded upper lids, often with a slight squint; darker skin and mild bags beneath; outer corners level to slightly down.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, sloping slightly down at the tails, with heavier inner ends and a clear gap between them.

nose.bridge: Straight and fairly high from the front.
nose.hump: Slight convexity at mid-bridge in right profile.
nose.tip: Rounded and slightly bulbous, pointing slightly down.
nose.fight_damage: No clear deviation. The tip is reddened in the post-fight photo (temporary).

mouth.resting_expression: Closed and neutral to slightly pursed.

ears.protrusion: Stand moderately out from the head, easy to see above the tapered sides.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No clear cauliflower; the folds are well defined in the September 2025 studio stance and the post-fight photo. A small red spot on the left ear's concha in the September 2025 studio photos looks like a minor scab.

face.notable_marks_scars: Faint forehead lines and darker skin under the eyes. No permanent facial scars visible. Shoulder scratches and the red nose tip in the UFC Paris post-fight photo are temporary.

hair.style: Short textured dark cut: tapered sides with a mid fade (about 1 cm) and 4-6 cm on top pushed up and slightly forward with natural waves. Longer and wavier at UFC Paris (September 2025); a shorter crop in July 2024 and January 2023. No part.
hair.hairline: Fairly straight across the forehead with slightly recessed temple corners; dense.

facial_hair.colour: Very dark brown, near black, slightly warm.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, jaw and moustache, with neat edges.
facial_hair.length_mm: 20-30 mm at the chin, about 10-15 mm on the cheeks (2025); similar in 2023 and 2024.
facial_hair.shape: Full beard joined to a full moustache, trimmed with a fairly high, neat cheek line (from the sideburn to just above the moustache corners) and a neckline low on the upper neck. The bottom edge is slightly rounded-square and longest at the chin.

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the five samples marked in_average (four studio cheeks, one indoor cheek); each sample is the median of a small well-lit patch
skin.undertone: Warm, light olive-beige; slightly redder on the cheeks and nose.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles. Moderate dark body hair: a line down the abdomen, forearms and legs.

body.build: Tall, lean and long-limbed middleweight: 6 ft 3 in with a 75 in reach (reach equals height).
body.body_fat_notes: Visible abs and obliques, not deeply etched (September 2025 studio stance and the flag portrait).
body.shoulders: Broad, with rounded deltoids and a moderate trapezius.
body.arms: Long and lean-muscular, with strong forearms and dark arm hair.
body.waist: Narrow, giving a clear V-taper from the broad shoulders.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with moderate thighs and slim calves; dark leg hair.
body.posture: Upright and square-shouldered, arms relaxed at the sides.
body.notable_physique_traits: Height and long limbs, broad shoulders over a narrow waist, full dark beard.

tattoos_note: None visible on the face, neck, chest, abdomen, arms or legs in the two studio stances (January and September 2025), the UFC Paris fight photo or the flag portrait. His back is not seen in any of these photos.
accessories_seen: None notable. Holds a Palestinian flag in the backstage portrait.

kit.typical_shorts: September 2025 studio portrait: blue UFC shorts with white and navy tiger-stripe slashes, a black waistband with a white UFC wordmark, the crypto.com logo on his RIGHT thigh (viewer's left). January 2025 studio: blue shorts with white diagonal stripes on his left hip, a black inner panel and IMAVOV in white down his LEFT leg. UFC Paris (September 2025, red corner): the blue tiger-stripe kit.
kit.gloves: Black UFC 4 oz gloves in studio; red cuffs at UFC Paris.
kit.brand_note: UFC-issued kit; the January 2025 shorts carry a Venum mark.

morphs_extra._note: Targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (read by src/avatar3d.js). Medium-large, moderately stand-out ears with no cauliflower; a slightly rectangular head.

ethnicity_fit.basis: Fitted by eye to how MakeHuman's three shape bases reproduce what the photos show: a straight, fairly high bridge with a slight dorsal convexity, narrow, slightly hooded eyes with no inner-corner fold under a moderately prominent brow, medium lips and a broad forehead. Not assigned from name, nationality or heritage.
ethnicity_fit.confidence: low: check a render against the September 2025 headshot; the detail morphs work without this block

render_hints.skin_base: young_caucasian_male (swatch #e6b393) tinted toward tone_hex_recommended #d68f72. Texture picked by age and swatch colour only.
render_hints.hair: strand shell with a 4-6 cm wavy top (capped by the shell) and a mid fade on the sides, tinted #20140f
render_hints.beard: full beard shell 20-30 mm at the chin, #22130f, with a neat, fairly high cheek line

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, eye colour, skin range, build and the absence of front tattoos; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 9 photos: 2 freely licensed (Commons: a sharp January 2023 three-quarter, CC BY-SA 4.0, and a July 2024 interview frame, CC BY 3.0), 7 reference-only. He has not fought since September 6, 2025, so the newest dated photos are from UFC Paris fight week (September 2025); the flag portrait was posted in May 2026 but its shoot date is unknown. No confirmed 2026 photo was found. One right profile (UFC Paris weigh-in, small) and no left profile. What to watch: (1) The likeness rests on the long rectangular face, the narrow, hooded dark eyes under low straight brows, the straight medium-long nose with a slightly bulbous tip and the dense near-black full beard with a neat high cheek line. (2) Hair: a 4-6 cm wavy dark top over tapered sides, not a buzz. (3) Build: tall and long-limbed with broad shoulders and a narrow waist; lean, not bulky. (4) Ears stand out a little; no cauliflower. Macro values: ageOldM uses MakeHuman's 25-years-at-0.5, 90-years-at-1.0 mapping (age 30). heightUpM 0.27 matches other 190.5 cm fighters. l-/r- morphs are the character's own left and right.
